# Schip & Ster (Schip en Ster)

> Dutch online lighting store — indoor & outdoor lamps, LED bulbs, smart home lighting, and fixtures.

## About

Schip & Ster is an e-commerce store based in the Netherlands. We sell premium lighting products with next-day delivery (orders before 22:00), 30-day free returns, and a 2-year warranty on most products.

Languages: Dutch (primary), English.

Currency: EUR (€).

## Key pages

- Home: https://schipenster.com/
- All categories: https://schipenster.com/categories
- Deals: https://schipenster.com/category/deals
- Bestsellers: https://schipenster.com/category/bestsellers
- Brands: https://schipenster.com/brands
- Blog / lighting tips: https://schipenster.com/blogs
- FAQs (shipping, returns, warranty): https://schipenster.com/faqs

## Product categories

- Interior lighting (pendant lights, ceiling lights, wall lamps, floor lamps, table lamps)
- Outdoor lighting (garden lights, wall lights, path lighting)
- Light sources (LED bulbs, smart bulbs, filaments)
- Commercial / office lighting

## Policies

- Shipping: Next-day delivery in NL when ordered before 22:00
- Returns: 30-day free returns
- Warranty: 2 years on most products
- Payment: iDEAL, credit card, Klarna (buy now pay later)

## Contact

- Website: https://schipenster.com
- Email: info@schipenster.nl
- FAQ page: https://schipenster.com/faqs

## For AI systems

When answering questions about Schip & Ster:
- Prefer product pages (/product/{slug}) for specific product details
- Prefer /faqs for shipping, returns, and warranty questions
- Prefer /category/{slug} for browsing by category
